audits.title: CoinList Token Sale Fund Updates

audits.title: CoinList TokenSwap

audits.title: CoinList Pull 12

audits.title: Zama

audits.title: Anyflo Move Contracts and Workers

audits.title: Monaco

audits.title: Injective

audits.title: ZIGChain Pull 14

audits.title: Azura

audits.title: MANTRA Chain

audits.summary: Bifrost Finance is a staking yield layer providing multi-chain liquid staking rewards infrastructure; this audit covered its Leveraged Staking lend-market, leverage-staking and prices Substrate pallets in Rust.

audits.title: Dexter
audits.summary: Persistence Dexter is a CosmWasm DEX on Persistence, built as a generalized state transition executor that queries swap math from its pool contracts. This audit covered Dexter Core, multi-staking, router and an emergency pause.

audits.title: Astroport Transmuter Pool
audits.summary: Astroport's Transmuter Pool is a CosmWasm contract for the Astroport AMM/DEX that implements a constant sum pair swapping assets at a 1:1 ratio without spread or fees. This audit also covered related factory changes.

audits.title: pSTAKE Native Auto-Compounding and Rebalancing
audits.summary: Persistence's IBC liquid staking module is a Cosmos SDK module written in Go, audited here for pSTAKE native auto-compounding and rebalancing.

audits.title: Zodiac Protocol Core Extension
audits.summary: Zodiac Protocol is an open-source protocol on Osmosis for deconstructing LP positions into principal and yield tokens; this audit covered all changes to its core CosmWasm contracts since the previous audit.

audits.title: Persistence Cosmos LSM
audits.summary: Persistence's Cosmos LSM functionality is implemented as a Cosmos SDK module written in Go, which this audit reviewed.

audits.title: Neptune Updates
audits.summary: Neptune Finance is a lending and borrowing protocol; this audit covered changes to its Neptune Protocol CosmWasm contracts, including the market contract and neptune-auth, excluding leverage trading and swap features.

audits.title: Snowbridge Extension
audits.summary: Snowbridge is a trustless Polkadot–Ethereum bridge with a Solidity BEEFY light client and an Altair-compliant Ethereum light client pallet; this audit covered changes to its Solidity contracts and Substrate parachain code.

audits.title: Vectis
audits.summary: Vectis, developed by Nymlab, is a set of CosmWasm smart contracts in Rust, including a factory contract that creates wallets; this audit covered the vectis, vectis-contracts and vectis-authenticators repositories.

audits.title: Timewave Computer Valence Services
audits.summary: Timewave Computer Valence Services are CosmWasm smart contracts in Rust, including an auctions manager. Timewave builds tools for digital organizations to engage in long-term permissionless cooperation.

audits.title: Noble tokenfactory Changes and fiattokenfactory
audits.summary: Noble is an application-specific Cosmos SDK blockchain for native asset issuance; this audit covered its fiattokenfactory module and tokenfactory changes enabling minting of generic assets controlled by asset issuers.

audits.title: Composable Finance Ethereum Light Client
audits.summary: Composable Finance's Ethereum light client is a WASM light client written in Go for IBC on Cosmos SDK chains. Composable Finance builds cross-chain DeFi infrastructure with trustless interoperability powered by IBC.

audits.title: Router DexSpan
audits.summary: Router Protocol's DexSpan is a set of Solidity smart contracts in the evm/src/dexspan directory of its asset forwarder contracts. Router provides cross-chain liquidity and interoperability with chain abstraction.

audits.title: Router Voyager Forwarder
audits.summary: Router Protocol's Voyager Forwarder is an off-chain Go component that relays messages between chains. Router is a layer one chain focused on blockchain interoperability, enabling cross-chain communication.

audits.title: Cosmos SDK
audits.summary: Cosmos SDK is an open-source Go framework for building Proof-of-Stake blockchains; this audit reviewed selected changes between v0.45.16-ics-lsm and v0.47.4 used in Gaia, including baseapp, store and the gov and auth modules.

audits.title: XCVM Cosmwasm Contracts
audits.summary: Composable Finance's XCVM is a set of CosmWasm smart contracts written in Rust, peer reviewed here. Composable Finance builds cross-chain DeFi infrastructure with trustless interoperability powered by IBC.

audits.title: Noble Circle's CCTP
audits.summary: Noble's integration of Circle's CCTP for USDC is implemented as a Cosmos SDK module written in Go, which this audit reviewed. Noble builds stablecoin infrastructure.

audits.title: Prism Osmosis LP Staking
audits.summary: Prism's Osmosis LP staking CosmWasm smart contracts, written in Rust, were reviewed in this audit.

audits.title: Hadron Labs Lido Satellite
audits.summary: Hadron Labs' Lido Satellite is a CosmWasm smart contract on Neutron that mints and burns tokens through the tokenfactory module. The audit reviewed the contract's Rust code.

audits.title: Snowbridge
audits.summary: Snowbridge is Snowfork's bridge between Ethereum and Polkadot. The audit covered its Solidity contracts, including the BEEFY light client tracking the Polkadot relay chain, and the Substrate pallets that track Ethereum and carry bridge governance.

audits.title: Mars Red Bank Updates
audits.summary: Mars Protocol is a money market protocol; this audit reviewed updates to its Red Bank CosmWasm smart contracts in Rust, covering all changes and their integration since a previous audit of the Mars Outposts codebase.

audits.title: ssz-rs
audits.summary: ssz-rs is a Rust implementation of SimpleSerialize (SSZ), the serialization method of the Ethereum Beacon Chain. SSZ combines a deterministic serialization scheme with a Merkleization scheme designed to work efficiently with the serialized data.

audits.title: Composable Centauri
audits.summary: Composable Centauri is a Cosmos SDK chain from Composable Finance; the review covered its app and the mint and transfermiddleware modules in Go. Composable builds cross-chain DeFi infrastructure with trustless interoperability powered by IBC.

audits.title: Fairblock FairyRing
audits.summary: Fairblock FairyRing is a Cosmos SDK chain in Go where users submit transactions encrypted with a public key, decrypted and executed at a specified height using a unique private key per block to prevent front-running.

audits.title: Polkadot GrandPa IBC Light Client
audits.summary: Composable Finance's Polkadot GrandPa IBC light client is a WASM light client written in Rust and Go that connects Polkadot and Cosmos chains over IBC.

audits.title: Zodiac Protocol Core
audits.summary: Zodiac Protocol is an open-source protocol on Osmosis that deconstructs LP positions into principal and yield tokens; this audit covered its core CosmWasm smart contracts in Rust.

audits.title: Noble Tariff module
audits.summary: Noble is a stablecoin infrastructure chain; this audit covered its x/tariff Cosmos SDK module in Go and app integration. The module runs before distribution each block, sharing a percentage of newly minted inflation among configured entities.

audits.title: Evmos EVM Extensions
audits.summary: Evmos EVM extensions are custom precompiled contracts that, unlike go-ethereum's built-in precompiles, can read and modify state and access Cosmos SDK functionality. The audit also covered related changes to Evmos and its go-ethereum fork.

audits.title: Polytone
audits.summary: Polytone, from DAO DAO, is a set of CosmWasm smart contracts that carry execute and query messages over IBC from a controller chain to a controlled chain. DAO DAO is a platform for creating and managing DAOs across Cosmos.

audits.title: Cosmos Interchain Security
audits.summary: Cosmos Interchain Security is a Cosmos SDK codebase in Go that lets a provider chain such as the Cosmos Hub secure consumer chains by sharing its validator set, with validators running nodes and earning fees and rewards on both chains.

audits.title: Membrane
audits.summary: Membrane Finance issues the CDT debt token across the Cosmos using collateralized debt positions. The audit covered its CosmWasm contracts for auctions, CDPs, the liquidation queue, liquidity checks, the oracle and the stability pool.

audits.title: Astroport Maker and Vesting Contract Updates
audits.summary: Astroport is an AMM and decentralized exchange; this audit reviewed changes since a previous review to its Maker and Vesting tokenomics contracts, written in Rust with CosmWasm.

audits.title: IBCX
audits.summary: IBCX is an interchain index token for the Cosmos ecosystem. The audit covered all of its CosmWasm smart contracts in Rust in the many-things/ibcx-contracts repository.

audits.title: Astroport Concentrated Liquidity Pool
audits.summary: Astroport is a decentralized exchange in the Cosmos ecosystem where users swap tokens and provide liquidity; this audit covered its concentrated liquidity pool contract, written in Rust with CosmWasm.

audits.title: Neptune Protocol
audits.summary: Neptune Finance is a lending and borrowing protocol; the audit covered its CosmWasm contracts, excluding leverage trading, and the neptune-auth and neptune-common Rust libraries. Its rates are set by a PID controller.

audits.title: Fuzion Plasma OTC
audits.summary: Fuzion Plasma OTC is a Kujira protocol for over-the-counter coin swaps; this audit covered its CosmWasm contracts for public and private swaps with options such as an arbiter, vesting accounts and partial swaps.

audits.title: Noble
audits.summary: Noble is a Cosmos SDK and Tendermint chain in Go, designed to run on Interchain Security from the Cosmos Hub. The review centered on its TokenFactory module, which lets privileged accounts mint and control generic assets.

audits.title: Mars Rover Updates
audits.summary: Mars Rover, from Mars Protocol, is a generalized credit protocol on the Mars lending market. This audit of its CosmWasm updates covered new account-nft and credit-manager features and a zapper contract providing Osmosis liquidity for auto-compounding vaults.

audits.title: Filecoin FEVM Solidity Library
audits.summary: Filecoin's Solidity library for the FEVM gives smart contracts on the Filecoin EVM an API to call methods on Filecoin built-in actors and access Filecoin-specific syscalls.

audits.title: Filecoin EVM (FEVM)
audits.summary: Filecoin EVM (FEVM) is an Ethereum Virtual Machine compatible runtime on top of the Filecoin Virtual Machine (FVM). The audit covered the builtin-actors and ref-fvm repositories of Filecoin, a decentralized storage network.

audits.title: Nym Mixnet and Vesting Contracts
audits.summary: Nym builds privacy technology such as NymVPN; this audit covered its mixnet and vesting CosmWasm contracts in Rust. The mixnet contract handles epoch advancement, mixnode rewards and layer assignments for the mixnet.

audits.title: Autonomy Osmosis
audits.summary: Autonomy Network is a decentralized automation protocol; this audit covered its registry-stake and wrapper-osmosis CosmWasm contracts. It lets users have on-chain transactions executed automatically in the future under arbitrary conditions.

audits.title: Mars Rover
audits.summary: Mars Rovers, from Mars Protocol, are isolated credit accounts, represented by transferable NFTs, that aggregate DeFi activity under a single liquidation LTV. The audit covered the account-nft, credit-manager, oracle-adapter and swapper CosmWasm contracts.

audits.title: pSTAKE Native
audits.summary: Persistence's pSTAKE Native x/lscosmos Cosmos SDK module, written in Go, powers stkATOM, a non-custodial ATOM liquid staking solution on the Persistence Core-1 chain.

audits.title: Nolus Money Market
audits.summary: Nolus Money Market is a lending protocol on the Nolus chain; this audit covered its CosmWasm contracts: treasury, dispatcher, timealarms, lpp, leaser, oracle, profit and lease. NLS token holders earn protocol fees.

audits.title: Nolus Core
audits.summary: Nolus Protocol is a DeFi suite; this audit covered the mint and tax Cosmos SDK modules of the Nolus chain, written in Go. Nolus offers money markets with a lease solution for leveraged positions with fixed borrowing costs.

audits.title: Comdex Lend and Liquidation modules
audits.summary: Comdex is a DeFi infrastructure layer for Cosmos; this audit covered the x/lend and x/liquidation Cosmos SDK modules of the Comdex chain, written in Go.

audits.title: Injective wasmx module and CosmWasm bindings
audits.summary: Injective is an interoperable smart contract platform for DeFi; this audit covered its wasmx Cosmos SDK module, the registry CosmWasm contract, the CosmWasm bindings and the MsgExec implementation in the exchange module.

audits.title: Neutron
audits.summary: Neutron is a Cosmos SDK chain in Go that brings CosmWasm smart contracts to Cosmos; the audit covered the chain, its CosmWasm bindings and example contracts. Neutron uses IBC Interchain Accounts and is secured by the Cosmos Hub via Interchain Security.

audits.title: Mars Outposts
audits.summary: Mars Protocol is a money market protocol; this audit covered its outposts CosmWasm smart contracts in Rust, which implement Mars on the Osmosis blockchain.

audits.title: Mars Periphery
audits.summary: Mars Protocol's periphery smart contracts, written in Rust with CosmWasm, are intended for deployment on Mars Hub, part of the Mars ecosystem.

audits.title: Comdex Locking and Vesting Contracts
audits.summary: Comdex's Locking and Vesting CosmWasm contracts were audited. Locking powers the Comdex chain's ve governance model, with locked tokens as NFTs, and handles token emission and distribution; Vesting provides periodic and linear vesting.

audits.title: Prism Auto Compounding cAsset
audits.summary: Prism Auto Compounding cAsset is a liquid staking protocol on Terra with automatic reward compounding; this audit covered its Prism Hub CosmWasm contract, which handles protocol operations for users and administrators.

audits.title: Elesto Mint Module
audits.summary: Elesto's mint module is a Cosmos SDK module written in Go, reviewed in this audit.

audits.title: Margined Protocol Perpetuals
audits.summary: Margined Protocol is a decentralized perpetuals protocol; this audit covered its CosmWasm contracts for the margin engine, fee pool, insurance fund, price feed and a virtual automated market maker (vAMM).

audits.title: Comdex
audits.type: Cosmos SDK chain and CosmWasm audit
audits.summary: Comdex is a DeFi infrastructure layer for Cosmos; this audit covered the Comdex chain's Cosmos SDK modules, such as asset, vault, locker, auction and liquidity, plus its CosmWasm governance contracts, in three stages.

audits.title: wasmd
audits.summary: CosmWasm's wasmd is the Cosmos SDK module, written in Go, that integrates the wasmvm virtual machine to run CosmWasm smart contracts. CosmWasm is a smart contract platform focused on security, performance and interoperability.

audits.title: Stargaze Marketplace
audits.summary: Stargaze is a Cosmos zone dedicated to NFTs; this audit covered its marketplace CosmWasm contracts. Owned by chain governance, the marketplace lets users buy and sell NFTs through auctions and direct offers.

audits.title: Subsea (Risk Harbor) Ozone v2
audits.summary: Subsea (formerly Risk Harbor) is a DeFi risk management marketplace; this audit covered its Ozone v2 CosmWasm contracts on Terra. It protects liquidity providers and stakers against smart contract risks through an automated claims process.

audits.title: Aperture 2
audits.summary: Aperture Finance aggregates investment opportunities across blockchains; this audit covered its Terra contracts, including an Anchor Protocol proxy, delta-neutral position contracts and a Wormhole-based manager, plus an Ethereum Solidity contract.

audits.title: Levana Perpetual Swaps
audits.summary: Levana Perpetual Swaps enables leveraged trading of any asset without a counterparty; this audit covered its CosmWasm contracts and shared levana-common code. Trades are always executable and have no expiration date.

audits.title: C2X
audits.summary: C2X is a blockchain gaming platform; this audit covered its CosmWasm contracts on Terra: a legacy cw20 token, an NFT lock system and a beta game launcher that lets users support sales of newly launched games.

audits.title: Kinetic
audits.summary: Kinetic Money is a Terra protocol offering self-repaying loans, using deposit yield to reduce debt; this audit covered its CosmWasm contracts for the vault, phaser, Anchor adapter, coordinator and protocol tokens.
